arbitration_rule_frozen: third senior human; never an LLM or the pipeline author; all three labels + reason retained
deblinding_risks_partial_blinding: Identity blinding is PARTIAL: folder names and the mapping are blinded, but verbatim patch/problem/probe text may quote the upstream issue number.
G3-C.1: all 8 packets self-reference the issue number in 08_issue_symptom_probe.log; P02(=19495) additionally in 02_candidate_patch.diff.
G3-A: only P04/P05/P06/P10 self-reference in 02_candidate_patch.diff; P01/P02/P03/P07/P08/P09 contain no self-reference.

Mitigations available WITHOUT rewriting evidence (which would corrupt the adjudication target): (a) instruct annotator2 not to look up issue numbers and treat any seen number as non-informative; (b) future hardening - a copied-verbatim hash-only-id appendix; (c) record the partial-blinding limitation as a known bias in the adjudication report.

Risk if an annotator recognises an issue or searches it upstream: label could be anchored to the upstream merged/closed status; such packets must be flagged and adjudicated rather than silently trusted.
decision_standard: Use the frozen 3-label rubric exactly: ACCEPT (all declared F2P transition and no declared scoped P2P regression; record SCOPED acceptability), REJECT (at least one decisive APPLICABLE failure: a declared F2P still failing OR a scoped P2P regression, after separating environment/pre-existing/xfail/flaky/self-added-test cases), NEEDS_REVIEW (genuinely undecidable). Do not force ACCEPT/REJECT.
Record the decisive failing test node id(s), a 1-4 sentence applicability reason, any xfail/flaky/self-added-test concern, and confidence (high/medium/low) in the blinded CSV.
Judgement is based ONLY on the packet contents; the issue number, model verdict, annotator-1 gold and freshness/coverage analyses are withheld.

focused_review_items.FR1: sympy-19495 probe: instrument-only fix vs post-hoc oracle redefinition after observing patch success (approver Risk B)
focused_review_items.FR2: 14248 vs 15875: confirm one uniform disjunctive REJECT standard across the two failure modes (approver section II.1)

required_competency: Reads modern pytest verbose node lines AND terminal summaries, and understands that old SymPy raised sympy.utilities.pytest.XFail/Skipped which modern pytest prints as FAILED (must recover via the terminal summary, not count as a regression).
Understands FAIL_TO_PASS vs in-scope PASS_TO_PASS, scoped vs full-suite acceptability, and pre-existing-bad (fails at clean baseline) vs candidate-induced regression.
Can read unified diffs of candidate and maintainer test patches and spot self-added-test / tautological-test traps.

Comfortable with SymPy idioms (ConditionSet/ImageSet, printing backends, core arithmetic) well enough to judge whether an exception is a genuine wrong-answer vs an environment/NumPy/recursion-limit artifact.
INDEPENDENT of the pipeline author and of the models that generated the patches; has never seen annotator-1 gold, model verdicts, or the analysis outputs.
rubric_note: Same three labels and same decision structure (F2P transition + scoped P2P no-regression; separate environment/preexisting/xfail/flaky/self-added-test; scoped acceptability). Wording differs slightly (G3-C.1 adds 'the full dataset P2P suite was not run for this pilot'); semantic criteria are aligned, so one annotator can use one rubric.
stage_stop_rules: No second human was obtained within Gate G3-C.1.1, therefore 18/18 remain PENDING and PROVISIONAL; no Gold Adjudication Version is created.
AI-generated labels are forbidden and none are written.

Two approver-mandated FOCUSED reviews are also left for the human and must be resolved before G3-C.2: FR1 sympy-19495 probe instrument-fix vs post-hoc oracle redefinition (Risk B); FR2 whether 14248 and 15875 apply one uniform disjunctive REJECT standard (section II.1).
third_person_arbitration_path: On annotator1 vs annotator2 disagreement (label differs, or ACCEPT/REJECT vs NEEDS_REVIEW), a THIRD senior human arbitrates independently.
The third arbitrator must not be an LLM and must not be the pipeline author or either annotator; receives the same blinded packet plus both labels and reasons, with no identity reveal.
The arbitrator issues one of the three labels with a reason; all three labels and reasons are retained verbatim (no silent overwrite).

Only after real annotator2 labels + required adjudication are returned may a new Gold Adjudication Version be produced and gold be raised above PROVISIONAL. No AI self-assessment may substitute at any step.
workload_estimate: 18 packets x 9 files each; pytest logs up to ~100 KB per run (3 logs per issue: f2p, scoped p2p after, scoped p2p clean baseline), plus problem statement, candidate patch, maintainer test patch and symptom-probe log.
Estimated ~25-40 minutes per packet for a careful reader; budget roughly 9-12 person-hours total including a short calibration pass.
Calibration: label 2 non-cohort practice packets first (not counted), resolve rubric questions, then label all 18 independently without feedback and without unsealing.
